title: feat(sceneview): SplatNode — 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering (Android Filament custom material; iOS RealityKit native; web follows)
abstract:
3D Gaussian Splatting epic. Shipped: KMP PLY/SPZ parsers (#2684), Android `SplatNode` + `splat.mat` (#2681), `splat-preview` demo (#2720, rebuilt around a real phone capture in #3659), web `SplatNode` (#2771).

Live:
- [ ] **Anisotropic 2D-covariance projection** in `splat.mat` / `splat_web.mat`. The P1 isotropic billboard renders the #3659 Real-World Scan hazy and over-bright, and that shows in the Play demo (capture `docs/ux/captures/android-3620-splat-preview-2026-09-16/`). Next on this track.
- [ ] **iOS `SplatNode`** on RealityKit `GaussianSplatComponent` (OS 27). `SceneViewSwift` has no splat code, and this epic is the only owner (#2768 closed).
- [ ] **`KHR_gaussian_splatting` glTF parsing**: not implemented.
- [ ] **SH degree > 0** colour.
- [ ] **AR-portal demo**: "step into your Scaniverse scan / a Marble world".
- [ ] **Large-scan streaming / LOD** beyond the ~500k-splat cap.
```

Two decisions only you can make:
- #3445: I chose superseded because #3958 (filed today) and #3783 cover everything left. #3958's body does still name #3445 as the "demo fold" owner, so the close comment explains where each remaining item went.
- #2648: all the code has shipped. Whether it stays open for a device pass or closes is your call.
